# Musing

> Musing is a free, private notes app for iPhone and Mac. Capture text, voice, and photos. Find them later by asking in plain language — on-device, with no folders or tags.

Notes stay on your devices and sync through your own private iCloud. Search, Ask, and understanding run on-device with Apple Intelligence. There are no ads, accounts, subscriptions, or credits. Optional Pro Mode lets you bring your own Perplexity, Anthropic, or OpenAI key for cited web search.
